name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – Recital C – Am 49
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: C. whereas the MFF mid-term revision agreed in 2024 proved to be imperative to address emerging priorities and challenges, and whereas the lack of resources continues to undermine the current MFF to this day; whereas, however, exceptional financing instruments cannot be made permanent as a result of transitional measures;
